types.name: type
types.description:
The claim's type. If `refund`, it means the claim's items
are returned and the customer is refunded. If `replace`, it
means the merchant will send new items in place of the returned items.

types.name: order_id
types.description: The ID of the order this claim is created for.

types.name: internal_note
types.description: An internal note viewed by admin users only.

types.name: reason_id
types.description: The ID of the associated reason.
